title: Asian Satay Tofu Noodles
subtitle: with Spring Onion
description: Looking for dinner on the table quick smart? This fast recipe is ready in 25 minutes or less and comes with yumness guaranteed.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Thinly slice the capsicum. Halve the carrot lengthwise and thinly slice on an angle. Thinly slice the spring onion on an angle, keeping the white and green parts separate. Quarter the tofu pieces. Combine 1 tbs soy sauce, 2 tsp white vinegar and 1 tsp honey in a bowl.

Warm tofu: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden and warmed through. Remove from the pan.

Cook noodles: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the same pan over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the capsicum and carrot for 3-4 mins until tender. Meanwhile, cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 2 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking.

Finish stir-fry: Add the Balinese seasoning and white part of the spring onion to the veggies and stir-fry for 30 secs or until combined. Add the tofu, noodles and sauce mixture and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until combined and warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat.

Fry eggs and serve up: If adding the fried eggs (see Make it yours), heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a small frypan over medium heat. Crack 2 eggs into the pan and cook for 3-4 mins until just set or cooked to your liking. Remove from the pan. Divide the noodles among bowls, top with the fried eggs and scatter with the remaining spring onion. Enjoy!
Make it yours: If you prefer, make an omelette instead of frying the eggs. Thinly slice and scatter over the noodles to serve.
